description: A PHP source file defining a class 'Sanitizer' for sanitizing and validating HTML/XHTML content, including functions for decoding and encoding character references, fixing tag attributes, removing tags/comments, and whitelisting attributes.

classes.name: Sanitizer
classes.description: A class providing static methods for sanitizing and validating HTML/XHTML content, including functions for decoding/encoding character references, fixing attributes, and removing dangerous tags.

methods.name: removeHTMLtags
methods.description: Removes dangerous HTML tags and comments from input text, with optional callback processing.

methods.name: removeHTMLcomments
methods.description: Removes HTML comments from the input text.

methods.name: validateTagAttributes
methods.description: Validates and whitelists attributes for specific tags.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Validates and whitelists attributes based on a whitelist.

methods.name: mergeAttributes
methods.description: Merges two attribute arrays, combining class attributes.

methods.name: checkCss
methods.description: Sanitizes CSS styles, rejecting unsafe expressions.

methods.name: fixTagAttributes
methods.description: Normalizes and escapes tag attributes, returning a string suitable for HTML.

methods.name: encodeAttribute
methods.description: Encodes attribute values for safe HTML output.

methods.name: safeEncodeAttribute
methods.description: Encodes attribute values with extra escaping to prevent further processing.

methods.name: escapeId
methods.description: Escapes a value for use as an HTML ID attribute, ensuring valid characters.

methods.name: escapeClass
methods.description: Escapes a value for use as a CSS class name.

methods.name: escapeHtmlAllowEntities
methods.description: Escapes HTML while preserving entities.

methods.name: decodeTagAttributes
methods.description: Decodes tag attributes from a string into an associative array.

methods.name: decodeEntity
methods.description: Returns UTF-8 character for named entities or escapes unknown entities.

methods.name: decodeCharReferences
methods.description: Decodes all character references in a string to UTF-8.

methods.name: normalizeCharReferences
methods.description: Normalizes character references, ensuring they are valid for XML/XHTML.

methods.name: attributeWhitelist
methods.description: Returns allowable attributes for a given element.

methods.name: setupAttributeWhitelist
methods.description: Sets up the static whitelist of allowed attributes for various elements.

methods.name: stripAllTags
methods.description: Removes all HTML tags from a fragment, returning plain text.

methods.name: hackDocType
methods.description: Generates a DOCTYPE with entity declarations for XHTML parsing.

methods.name: cleanUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes URLs, removing control characters and validating hostname.
